Deep inside Guatemala's Maya Biosphere Reserve lies El Mirador, an ancient Maya city that may hold the secrets of a powerful ruling dynasty known as the Snake Kings. Josh Gates meets Dr. Stanley Gunter to explore the mysteries of Maya history before venturing into the jungle to investigate the lost city and its hidden tombs. Can Josh uncover clues to the fate of the Snake Kings and the fall of this once-great civilisation?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 4, Episode 13, on Discovery Channel India.
